approved.title: KENYA INSTITUTE OF CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT (KICD) CBC LESSON PLAN
approved.subtitle: Creative Arts and Sports (CAS) - Grade 7
approved.subject: CAS

sections.heading: Administrative Details
items: School: Bahari Girls Junior School
Teacher: Tr. Jane M. Mwangi
Learning Area: Creative Arts and Sports
Grade/Class: Grade 7
Term: Term 1
Strand: Creating and Performing in Creative Arts
Sub-strand: Drawing (Still Life)
Duration: 35 Minutes
Date: 12th February 2024

sections.heading: Specific Learning Outcomes
items: Knowledge: Identify elements of line, form, and tonal value in still life drawing compositions.
Skill: Apply appropriate shading techniques (cross-hatching and blending) to create depth and form in a drawing of still life objects.
Attitude: Value the aesthetic quality of shadow and light in visual representation.

sections.heading: Key Inquiry Question
sections.body: How does the distribution of light and shadow turn a flat two-dimensional drawing into a realistic three-dimensional form?

sections.heading: Core Competencies
items: Creativity and Imagination: Expressed through observing light patterns and rendering form using pencil techniques.
Communication and Collaboration: Developed through peer-review discussions on drawing techniques.
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Analyzing the direction of light and translating depth onto a 2D page.

sections.heading: Values to be Developed
items: Respect: Displayed while offering and receiving constructive peer feedback.
Responsibility: Evidenced through proper handling and maintenance of art media and tools.
Integrity: Expressed through original creation of visual works.

sections.heading: Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs)
items: Environmental Sustainability: Reusing locally available household containers and fruits as objects for still life arrangements.

sections.heading: Learning Resources
items: Graphite Pencils (2B, 4B, 6B)
Drawing Paper / Art Sketchbooks
Erasers and Sharpeners
Still Life Setup (A ceramic cup and an apple on a flat wooden surface)
KICD Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports Teacher's Guide and Learner's Book

sections.heading: Organisation of Learning (35 Minutes Total)
items: Phase 1: Introduction (5 Minutes) — Teacher displays a real ceramic cup under a single light source. Learners observe and discuss where light hits directly (highlight) and where shadows fall. Key inquiry question is posed.

Phase 2: Demonstration & Instruction (8 Minutes) — Teacher demonstrates drawing the basic contours of the cup and apple on the whiteboard/sketchpad, showing how to apply cross-hatching to build dark, medium, and light tones according to the light source position.

Phase 3: Learner Practice / Guided Activity (15 Minutes) — Learners work individually at their desks to sketch the still life setup (cup and apple). They apply graphite shading (hatching/cross-hatching) to capture shadows, mid-tones, and highlights. Teacher moves around offering individual support and corrective guidance.

Phase 4: Conclusion & Plenary (7 Minutes) — Learners pin their work on a display board or leave it open on desks for a gallery walk. Learners highlight successful shading techniques in peer drawings. Teacher summarizes main points and collects art books.

sections.heading: Assessment Methods
items: Direct Observation of technique execution during practice
Peer Assessment during gallery walk based on tonal variation criteria
Portfolio Assessment (Rubric evaluating proportional accuracy, tonal value range, and clean presentation)

sections.heading: Teacher's Self-Reflection
sections.body: To be completed post-lesson: Evaluate whether learners successfully depicted 3D form using tonal gradation, note learners requiring remedial instruction in cross-hatching, and assess time management efficiency during practical work.
